definitions.crossing: first t on/after 2026-09-29T07:00Z where flow(t) minus the lowest flow in the 24 h ending at t >= 100 cfs
definitions.episode: armed at first t with flow >= 150 and >= 1.5 x lowest flow in the 72 h up to t; episodeStart = time of that lowest flow
definitions.running_high: max flow since episodeStart; its time is the FIRST sample reaching that value
definitions.call: flow <= 0.98 x running high and now - high time >= 90 min; confirmedT is the call time
definitions.solid_rain_end: endT of the last hour with mm >= 1 followed by two consecutive hours < 1 mm (hours are 'valid hour end' times, UTC)
definitions.tolerance_note: gauge is 15-min; assert times to the exact 15-min step given here, which the extractor computed on the verbatim series

tieRuleSensitivity.note: The flow sits at 191 cfs from 04:00Z to 05:45Z. With the running high stamped at the FIRST sample reaching it (the rule used above) the call is at 06:30Z (23:30 PT); stamping it at the LAST tied sample moves the call to the first sample >= 90 min after 05:45Z and <= 0.98 x 191, which is after 23:30 PT. The integrator must pin the tie rule; the test asserts the first-sample rule.
